result.instructions: Tools for WorkGuru, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which projects are open for our biggest client, and what is their status?"; "Show invoices from last month that have not been sent to the client yet."; "How many hours did each staff member log on project X this week?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes WorkGuru data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run workguru_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run workguru_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run workguru_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. workguru_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: workguru_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List client names and ids (WorkGuru clients). Use the ids to match projects and invoices. WorkGuru API: GET /api/services/app/Client/GetAllClientNamesAndIds.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-200, default 50). WorkGuru sends the whole list; the tool cuts it to this size.

tools.name: workguru_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects with their number, name, status, dates, client, project manager and line items. WorkGuru API: GET /api/services/app/Project/GetAllProjects.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-200, default 50). WorkGuru sends the whole list; the tool cuts it to this size.

tools.name: workguru_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their number, date, due date, status, client, project and totals. WorkGuru API: GET /api/services/app/Invoice/GetAllInvoices.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-200, default 50). WorkGuru sends the whole list; the tool cuts it to this size.

tools.name: workguru_list_leads
tools.title: List leads
tools.description: List sales leads with their name, stage, category, owner, budget and forecast close date. WorkGuru API: GET /api/services/app/Lead/GetAllLeads.

excludeWonOrLost.description: Leave out leads that are won or lost.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-200, default 50). WorkGuru sends the whole list; the tool cuts it to this size.

tools.name: workguru_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List contacts (people) with their name, email, phone, position and client or supplier. WorkGuru API: GET /api/services/app/Contact/GetAllContacts.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-200, default 50). WorkGuru sends the whole list; the tool cuts it to this size.

tools.name: workguru_list_timesheets
tools.title: List timesheets
tools.description: List timesheet entries (user, project, task, start and finish time, hours, status) for a date range, optionally for one staff member. WorkGuru API: GET /api/services/app/TimeSheet/GetAllTimeSheetsInDateRange.

staffId.description: Only this staff member's entries (WorkGuru user id).

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-200, default 50). WorkGuru sends the whole list; the tool cuts it to this size.

tools.name: workguru_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products (catalogue items) with their name, price, cost, stock and unit of measure. WorkGuru API: GET /api/services/app/Product/GetAllProducts.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-200, default 50). WorkGuru sends the whole list; the tool cuts it to this size.

tools.name: workguru_list_task_types
tools.title: List task types
tools.description: List the task catalogue: named labour or service items with rate, unit cost and account code. WorkGuru API: GET /api/services/app/Task/GetAllTasks.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (1-200, default 50). WorkGuru sends the whole list; the tool cuts it to this size.
